item.text:
Subject: Timely Circulation of Meeting Notes

Dear Club Committee,

Could we aim to circulate meeting notes within two days of each meeting? Prompt notes would help members confirm decisions, responsibilities, and upcoming dates while discussions are still fresh. This could reduce misunderstandings and make it easier for anyone unable to attend to stay involved.

I appreciate the effort involved in preparing minutes and would be happy to help develop a simple template if useful.

Kind regards,
